title: Path payment whose claim atoms mix pools and the order book: [LIQUIDITY_POOL, ORDER_BOOK, LIQUIDITY_POOL]
why: A path payment's result lists one claim atom per hop, and since CAP-38 an atom is either an ORDER_BOOK offer or a LIQUIDITY_POOL; this one crosses pool, offer, pool. Readers that assume every atom is an offer (with a seller and offer ID) or every atom a pool mis-decode the trades and the amounts.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger (the Protocol 19 upgrade ledger; transactions applied under Protocol 18).

notes: Apply index 19 of 267; envelope tx_set.txs[7]. The fee and sequence source GDGPB46N… is not the operation source: GAFGEQYB… pays native and receives native (net +157184 stroops). Hops: pool LDO5BL7X… (native → USD), the offer 1004517540 of GAKD7CNO… (USD → RIO), pool LAHLXTCM… (RIO → native). The lake object was written by stellar-core 23.0.1 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
